task_completion.description: Run the baseline simulation and generate the performance CSV.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or file explorer showing the creation of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/baseline_network_performance.csv.

task_completion.description: Create the rerouter XML file closing at least two edges on the Acosta corridor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or cat command showing incident_rerouters.add.xml with at least two <closingLaneReroute> or <closingEdgeReroute> tags.

task_completion.description: Create the incident SUMO configuration file referencing the rerouter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor showing run_incident.sumocfg with an <additional-files> entry pointing to incident_rerouters.add.xml.

task_completion.description: Run the incident simulation and generate the performance CSV.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing sumo or sumo-gui running the incident config and the creation of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/incident_network_performance.csv.

task_completion.description: Compare baseline and incident metrics (trips, travel time, time loss, delay).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the agent comparing data from both CSV files, likely in a terminal, spreadsheet, or script output.

task_completion.description: Generate the final impact assessment report with all required sections.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or cat command showing /home/ga/SUMO_Output/incident_assessment_report.txt containing incident location, rerouting strategy, and percentage degradation.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually ran the SUMO simulation rather than fabricating results.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal logs showing the 'sumo' command being executed and the simulation step progress (e.g., 'Step #100.00').

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the specific paths requested in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing file paths like /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/ and /home/ga/SUMO_Output/ in commands or editor headers.

integrity.description: Ensure metrics in the report match the generated CSV data.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numbers in incident_assessment_report.txt should match the values visible in the generated CSV files.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires using the 'bologna_acosta' scenario. The agent must close at least 2 edges in incident_rerouters.add.xml. Key output files must be: /home/ga/SUMO_Output/baseline_network_performance.csv, /home/ga/SUMO_Output/incident_network_performance.csv, and /home/ga/SUMO_Output/incident_assessment_report.txt. The report must include: incident location, rerouting strategy, performance comparison, percentage degradation, and recommendations.
